title: A Treatise on Weighted Flame
summary: A treatise on packing fire so densely that it strikes with the weight of stone and holds a stance against heavy blows.

title: The Canon of the Rising Pyre
summary: A canon of fire called up from the ground in columns and rings that scorch groups and hold them where they stand.

title: The Field Flame Compendium
summary: A compendium on spreading fire qi round the body as a living field that senses and guards and burns whatever enters it.

title: The Shield-Piercing Fire Canon
summary: A canon on combustion that reaches inside a qi shield and burns the guard away from within.

title: The Twin Flame Treatise
summary: A treatise on fire held in both hands as a matched pair so that one burn opens the guard and the second lands.

title: The Hawk and Ember Compendium
summary: A compendium of fire that rises on heat and stoops from above like a hawk and spreads in ember wings.

title: Manual of the Two-Track Fire
summary: A manual on running fire along two tracks of the body at once so that strike and guard are carried in the same breath.

title: The Wind-Sworn Fire Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of fire that a wind-sworn student carries on the breath and reads by the bend of its flame.

title: The Oath of the Standing Flame
summary: A sworn manual of fire held from a fixed stance that does not give way and releases all at once at the end.

title: Manual of the Open Fire Bearing
summary: A manual of fire that is thrown in plain sight along a clear bearing and offers no cover to those it meets.
